name: Mycronic AB (publ)
summary: Täby, Sweden-based Mycronic AB (publ) is a global entity dedicated to crafting, manufacturing, and supplying specialized production machinery for the electronics sector. Its operational footprint spans Sweden, Europe, the Americas, and significant parts of Asia, including China and South Korea, underscoring its international presence. The company's business is structured into four primary divisions. The Pattern Generators segment focuses on engineering and producing mask writers and precision measuring devices. These tools are indispensable for creating advanced photomasks utilized in manufacturing display screens for diverse applications such as televisions, vehicles, mobile devices, tablets, and computers, as well as for semiconductor components. The High Flex division provides sophisticated surface mount technology (SMT) and inspection solutions, specifically designed for assembling flexible printed circuit boards (PCBs). Its offerings include the integrated MYPro Line, which combines advanced jet printing, dispensing, pick-and-place, process control, and 3D inspection capabilities, along with MYTower material handling systems and MYSmart dispensing and coating solutions. Addressing large-scale manufacturing needs, the High Volume segment produces equipment for precise dispensing and conformal coating of circuit boards, alongside automated screen printers. These solutions cater to manufacturers of mobile phones, tablets, computers, and electronic systems for electric vehicles. Finally, the Global Technologies segment delivers a range of specialized services and systems, including die-bonding for microelectronics and optoelectronic applications, advanced electrical measurement of bare board PCBs and substrates, automated flying probe test systems for complex, low-to-mid volume board verification, and grid test systems for high-volume bare board inspection. Mycronic markets its extensive product portfolio through a well-established network of agents and distributors. Its clientele extends across numerous industries, including industrial, aerospace, defense, automotive, energy, medical, and telecommunications. The company adopted its current name, Mycronic AB (publ), in June 2014, having previously operated as Micronic Mydata AB (publ).
